requirements.note: Inset-grouped Lists screen with Today (21) and All (135) on top and six lists below, each showing its open count. Counts update after edits.

Open tasks come first, then a 'Completed · 9' footer row with a Show/Hide text link that expands the completed tasks. The circle checkbox completes a task and reopens it, moving it between the sections.

+ opens a sheet with Title (focused, Add disabled until a title is entered), Notes, a Due Date toggle with a compact date picker, a Priority menu (None/Low/Medium/High) and a List picker. Tapping a row opens the same sheet as Details, which saves and has Delete Task.
Overdue dates are red with an 'Overdue ·' prefix. High priority shows a red '!!!' before the title.
An always-visible grip on each row reorders by dragging, and the order persists. Swiping a row left shows a red Delete button that removes the task.
+ on Lists opens a New List sheet. The list's ••• menu offers Rename List (sheet) and Delete List. Swiping a list left shows Delete, with an alert that says how many tasks it holds.
After relaunch the edited title and priority, the added task, the deletion, the reorder, the renamed list and the deleted list were all kept.

bugs: When the large title collapses, the small inline title ('Trip', 'All') sits over the scrolled rows with no bar background, so the two texts overlap ('2026Trip', 'Read the plumbAll').
Separators are inconsistent: there is a stray hairline above the first row under the large title, and one separator in the Trip list ran full width while the others were inset.
tells: Task lists are plain white full-bleed lists with a hairline above the first row, unlike the grouped style used on the Lists screen.
Reorder grips show on every row all the time instead of only in Edit mode.
The completed section is a 'Completed · 9  Show' row with a blue text link instead of a disclosure header with a chevron.
Every list has the same generic orange document icon; there are no per-list colours or SF Symbol list glyphs.
Dates always include the year ('Fri, Oct 30, 2026') even in the current year. All/Today rows run date and list name together with only a space ('Sat, Nov 7, 2026  Work').
The swiped row's Delete button is a floating red pill and separators do not move with the row, which looks slightly off compared with system swipe actions.

At the largest text size the task title wraps into a narrow column (Write the / garage) because the checkbox and grip keep a lot of width. Counts on the Lists screen sometimes wrap under the name and sometimes not.
Rows show as 'Link' elements to accessibility, a web-style tell.
A.scroll: Slow drags, flings and fling-back to the top were smooth, with no blank or popping rows, and the scroll position was kept after opening and cancelling a task. The only problem was the inline title overlapping content under a bar with no background.

requirements.note: Reminders-style inset-grouped Lists screen: Today (calendar glyph) and All (tray glyph) with counts, then My Lists with coloured circular list icons and open counts. Counts update.

Open tasks in a grouped section, then a 'Completed (10)' disclosure header with a chevron that collapses and expands the completed tasks (red filled checks). The checkbox completes and reopens; the ••• menu also has Show/Hide Completed.

A bottom-toolbar 'New Task' opens a sheet with Title, Notes, a Date toggle that expands an inline graphical calendar, Priority (None/Low/High) and List, all with Reminders-style icon tiles. Tapping a row opens Details with Save and Delete Task. Edits save.
Overdue tasks show a red exclamation-circle and red 'Sat, Oct 17 · Overdue'. High priority shows an orange '!!!' and low a grey '!'. Today groups tasks under an 'Overdue' header.
Edit mode shows the system delete and reorder controls. Dragging a row reorders it and the order survives relaunch. The system swipe action (trash, Delete) removes a task.

'Add List' in the toolbar opens a New List alert with a text field (Create disabled while empty). Renaming works from the ••• menu or a list swipe (Rename / Delete), and deleting asks for confirmation in an action sheet.
After relaunch the edited task, the added and deleted tasks, the reorder, the renamed list and the created and deleted list were all kept, along with the counts.

bugs: At the largest text size the task Details sheet breaks words inside the label column ('Pri' / 'ority', 'L' / 'ist'), and the List value is clipped and overlapping ('Er-' / 'rands' cut off).
The pinned 'Completed (10)' header slides under the navigation bar while scrolling, where it can't be tapped; a tap there lands on the bar instead.
tells: The edit form's row labels at accessibility sizes don't switch to a stacked layout the way system cells do, so labels and values fight for width.
Priority offers only None/Low/High, with no Medium.
In dark mode the selected day in the calendar is a white disc instead of the accent tint (minor).
B.scroll: It felt like a system table: smooth slow drags and flings with no blank rows, the large title collapsing into a proper inline bar with a scroll-edge blur, and a clean bounce back to the large title at the top.

why: Both apps meet all seven requirements and persist everything. B looks and behaves like Reminders throughout: grouped lists with coloured icons, a chevron Completed disclosure, system Edit-mode reorder and swipe actions, an inline calendar, and a correct collapsing navigation bar. A works but has clear tells: the inline title overlaps content, grips are always visible, the completed toggle is a text link, and dates always show the year. B's main flaw is its edit sheet at the largest text size.
